hash_contract: Each risk_sha256 is sha256:JCS(entry omitting risk_sha256); register_sha256 is sha256:JCS(root omitting register_sha256)

entries.title: Undetected cosmic-ray bit flip across every retained copy
entries.trigger: A correlated physical fault changes all copies and all compared digests into mutually consistent values.
entries.runtime_boundary: Single-machine evaluation and local evidence retention without a separately attested fault-tolerant store.

probability_or_exposure.statement: No declared runtime mechanism or exposure evidence demonstrates the correlated all-copy transformation.

impact.consequence: Evidence corruption could evade ordinary digest checks.

entries.rationale: Excluded because no demonstrable trigger exists in the declared boundary; ordinary byte mutation remains included.

entries.title: Cryptographic signature against a same-user attacker
entries.trigger: A same-user process reads or rewrites any key stored in the current local runtime.
entries.runtime_boundary: Current v2 uses hashes, nonces, append-only records, and authoritative event binding without a protected signing service.

probability_or_exposure.statement: The protocol explicitly forbids a signature claim before a separately protected key service exists.

impact.consequence: A false signature claim would overstate the provenance boundary.

entries.rationale: Excluded as a claimed guarantee; protocol mutation cases still verify the actual hash/nonce/event controls.

entries.title: Synthetic fixture treated as live Phase 0B capability proof
entries.trigger: A release gate attempts to promote an offline fixture result into a live Codex capability status.
entries.runtime_boundary: Phase 0A offline evaluation; the user has not authorized live Phase 0B children, restart, retention, or fault injection.

probability_or_exposure.statement: The current authorization permits frozen synthetic cases only and retains every live capability as UNVERIFIED.

impact.consequence: Phase 1-5 could start on capabilities that were never observed.

entries.rationale: Excluded from all positive capability effects; manifest-level policy makes the exclusion machine visible.

entries.title: Practical SHA-256 preimage construction
entries.trigger: An actor constructs chosen bytes with the exact SHA-256 digest of a frozen artifact during the release evaluation.
entries.runtime_boundary: Current offline contract review and release-gate time horizon.

probability_or_exposure.statement: No current capability or exposure evidence shows a practical SHA-256 preimage path in this time horizon.

entries.rationale: Excluded until a demonstrable trigger changes the cryptographic assumption; raw/JCS domain confusion remains included.

entries.title: Same-OS-administrator arbitrary tampering
entries.trigger: An administrator or arbitrary process under a privileged OS identity rewrites kernel state, evidence, or local keys.
entries.runtime_boundary: Outside the first-version threat boundary, which does not claim protection from OS administrators or arbitrary same-user processes.

probability_or_exposure.statement: The deployment supplies no independent OS identity or protected key service; accepting this scenario would create an unfalsifiable security claim.

impact.consequence: Complete provenance and state compromise if the excluded principal is malicious.

entries.rationale: Excluded until an independently protected execution and key boundary exists; no current case may claim resistance.
